note: v2.1 基准修正版：完整保留 v2 原始题目与评测记录，仅修正 V208 的统计口径，使其符合 metadata.global_rules.average_asset_population 与 branch_grouping。v2.1 已用于定向修复验证，只作为回归套件，不再宣称为无偏留出成绩。expected_behavior=clarify 的题不计入准确率。

items.question: 最新一期账户状态正常的客户占全部客户多少比例
items.standard_sql: select count(distinct case when cust_status='2000001' then pty_id end)*1.0/count(distinct pty_id) as ratio from ads_cust_info_d where data_dt='20260531'
items.note: 账户状态映射到字典代码，分母为最新快照全部客户

items.question: 哪个城市的客户最多，有多少人
items.standard_sql: select city_name,count(distinct pty_id) as cust_cnt from ads_cust_info_d where data_dt='20260531' group by city_name order by cust_cnt desc limit 1
items.note: 口语化排名，要求城市和客户数两列

items.question: 最新一期男性客户里，钻石卡客户占比是多少
items.standard_sql: select count(distinct case when cust_lvl_cd='1000001' then pty_id end)*1.0/count(distinct pty_id) as ratio from ads_cust_info_d where data_dt='20260531' and gender_cd='5000002'
items.note: 分母只包含男性客户，而不是全部客户

items.question: 2026年3月底持有开放式基金的硕士客户有多少
items.standard_sql: select count(distinct h.pty_id) as cust_cnt from dwd_cust_hold_d h join dim_product p on h.prdt_id=p.prdt_id join ads_cust_info_d c on h.pty_id=c.pty_id and c.data_dt='20260531' where h.data_dt='20260331' and p.up_prdt_type_name='开放式基金' and c.edu_cd='6000003'
items.note: 持仓、产品分类、客户学历三表关联

items.question: 2026年一季度只买过、没有卖过产品的客户有多少
items.standard_sql: with t as (select pty_id,sum(coalesce(buy_amt,0)) as buy_total,sum(coalesce(sell_amt,0)) as sell_total from dwd_cust_tran_d where data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' group by pty_id) select count(*) as cust_cnt from t where buy_total>0 and sell_total=0
items.note: 必须先按客户汇总整个季度，不能按单行交易判断

items.question: 2026年一季度各月发生交易的客户数分别是多少
items.standard_sql: select substr(data_dt,1,6) as mon,count(distinct pty_id) as cust_cnt from dwd_cust_tran_d where data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' group by substr(data_dt,1,6) order by mon
items.note: 按月统计去重客户数，跨月不去重

items.question: 每个客户等级中，2026年季末总资产最高的客户是谁
items.standard_sql: with ranked as (select c.cust_lvl_cd,c.pty_id,coalesce(a.nm_tot_aset,0)+coalesce(a.fc_pur_aset,0) as total_aset,row_number() over(partition by c.cust_lvl_cd order by coalesce(a.nm_tot_aset,0)+coalesce(a.fc_pur_aset,0) desc,c.pty_id) as rn from ads_cust_info_d c join dws_cust_aset_d a on c.pty_id=a.pty_id and a.data_dt='20260331' where c.data_dt='20260531') select cust_lvl_cd,pty_id,total_aset from ranked where rn=1 order by cust_lvl_cd
items.note: 分组 Top1，使用普通账户总资产加信用账户净资产

items.question: 2026年季末客户平均总资产超过100万的营业部有几个
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as branch_cnt from (select b.up_org_name,b.org_name,avg(coalesce(a.nm_tot_aset,0)+coalesce(a.fc_pur_aset,0)) as avg_aset from ads_cust_info_d c left join dws_cust_aset_d a on c.pty_id=a.pty_id and a.data_dt='20260331' join dim_branch b on c.org_id=b.org_id and b.data_dt=c.data_dt where c.data_dt='20260531' group by b.up_org_name,b.org_name having avg(coalesce(a.nm_tot_aset,0)+coalesce(a.fc_pur_aset,0))>1000000) t
items.note: 以最新客户快照为完整母体，无季末资产记录的客户按0纳入平均；按分公司名和营业部名直接分组，并将营业部维表限定到客户同一快照。修正后基准结果为2，原v2基准结果3保留在原记录中

items.question: 2026年一季度资金净流入超过10万的客户有多少
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cust_cnt from (select pty_id,sum(coalesce(cash_in,0)+coalesce(tran_in,0)+coalesce(assign_in,0)-coalesce(cash_out,0)-coalesce(tran_out,0)-coalesce(assign_out,0)) as net_inflow from dws_cust_fin_d where data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' group by pty_id having sum(coalesce(cash_in,0)+coalesce(tran_in,0)+coalesce(assign_in,0)-coalesce(cash_out,0)-coalesce(tran_out,0)-coalesce(assign_out,0))>100000) t
items.note: 净流入为三类流入减三类流出，先按客户聚合

items.question: 2026年一季度各分公司的资金净流入合计是多少
items.standard_sql: select b.up_org_name,sum(coalesce(f.cash_in,0)+coalesce(f.tran_in,0)+coalesce(f.assign_in,0)-coalesce(f.cash_out,0)-coalesce(f.tran_out,0)-coalesce(f.assign_out,0)) as net_inflow from dws_cust_fin_d f join ads_cust_info_d c on f.pty_id=c.pty_id and c.data_dt='20260531' join dim_branch b on c.org_id=b.org_id and b.data_dt='20260531' where f.data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' group by b.up_org_name order by net_inflow desc
items.note: 资金流水关联客户最新所属营业部，再映射到分公司

items.question: 2025年四季度客户资金流入总额是多少
items.standard_sql: select coalesce(sum(coalesce(cash_in,0)+coalesce(tran_in,0)+coalesce(assign_in,0)),0) as total_inflow from dws_cust_fin_d where data_dt between '20251001' and '20251231'
items.note: 数据库没有 2025 年数据，应返回 0 而不是编造数值

items.question: 资产比较高的客户有多少
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cust_cnt from dws_cust_aset_d where data_dt='20260331' and coalesce(nm_tot_aset,0)+coalesce(fc_pur_aset,0)>1000000
items.note: 比较高缺少阈值，理想行为是询问资产口径和阈值；基准仅作执行校验，不计入准确率

items.question: 2026年季末信用账户净资产为0、但普通账户现金余额不为0的客户有多少
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cust_cnt from dws_cust_aset_d where data_dt='20260331' and coalesce(fc_pur_aset,0)=0 and coalesce(nm_bal,0)>0
items.note: 同时处理两个账户字段的 NULL，并区分净资产为0与现金余额不为0

items.question: 2026年3月底持有ETF或LOF的客户有多少
items.standard_sql: select count(distinct h.pty_id) as cust_cnt from dwd_cust_hold_d h join dim_product p on h.prdt_id=p.prdt_id where h.data_dt='20260331' and p.prdt_type_name in ('ETF','LOF')
items.note: 产品二级分类枚举值过滤，并按客户去重

items.question: 2026年3月底有持仓但一季度没有任何交易的客户有多少
items.standard_sql: select count(*) as cust_cnt from (select distinct pty_id from dwd_cust_hold_d where data_dt='20260331') h where not exists (select 1 from dwd_cust_tran_d t where t.pty_id=h.pty_id and t.data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331')
items.note: 持仓与交易采用不同时间口径，反连接识别无交易客户

items.question: 2026年一季度有交易的客户中，季末持仓市值超过50万的客户占比是多少
items.standard_sql: with active as (select pty_id from dwd_cust_tran_d where data_dt between '20260101' and '20260331' group by pty_id having sum(coalesce(buy_amt,0)+coalesce(sell_amt,0))>0), hold as (select pty_id,sum(coalesce(mkt_val,0)) as total_mkt_val from dwd_cust_hold_d where data_dt='20260331' group by pty_id) select count(h.pty_id)*1.0/count(a.pty_id) as ratio from active a left join hold h on a.pty_id=h.pty_id and h.total_mkt_val>500000
items.note: 分母为季度有交易客户，分子为其中季末持仓市值超过50万的客户
